title: Full and principal-open affine compatibility of polynomial duality models
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and a polynomial restriction atlas for $K$ be as in [def-trf-polynomial-duality-restriction-atlas]. Let $\operatorname{Spec}A\to X$ and $\operatorname{Spec}R\to S$ be affine open charts over an $R$-algebra $A$, $M\in D(A)$, $e:K|_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\cong\widetilde M$ and a polynomial presentation system $F$ for $M$ [def-trf-polynomial-duality-presentation-data]. Using the canonical affine realization maps [def-trf-polynomial-duality-affine-atlas-comparison], define affine compatibility as follows, for every atlas chart identified with the affine closed immersion $\operatorname{Spec}A\to\operatorname{Spec}P$ for a quotient $p:P=R[x_0,\ldots,x_{n-1}]\twoheadrightarrow A$ over these fixed charts. The ordinary comparison $\widetilde{\operatorname{Res}_p N}\cong(\operatorname{Spec}p)_*\widetilde N$ must have adjunct the actual tilde/Gamma unit [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction], transported by the identity-on-elements global-sections comparison [lem-weil-pbc-pushforward-spec-global-sections]. Its derived comparison is constrained on every homotopy complex by the original right-derived units [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]; all exactness and composite-additivity proofs are included as proof data, not new hypotheses. The ambient coefficient isomorphism must send the ordered polynomial differential volume to the wedge of the derivatives of the actual coordinate functions. Define the affine model arrow as the sheaf-coinduction adjunct of the actual module-coinduction evaluation [def-trf-derived-coinduction], transported by those unit-normalized affine comparisons and native direct-image composition [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image-composition]. Require that the atlas identification equals the composite of the canonical open-restriction unit, the direct image of $e$, the associated-sheaf realization of $F$'s identification for $p$, and this independently defined affine model arrow. Thus the affine presentation identifications and the geometric atlas use the same comparison maps. Also impose the same compatibility on every principal ambient open $B=R[x_0,\ldots,x_{n-1}]_h$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. Define $\pi:R[x_0,\ldots,x_{n-1},t]\to B$ by the original coordinates and $t\mapsto h^{-1}$. Its coefficient comparison from derived coinduction of the $(n+1)$-variable top form to the localized $n$-variable top form is the adjunct of the shifted boundary for multiplication by $ht-1$. Normalize the quotient map by sending the new volume to $h^{-1}$ times the localized old volume. For a quotient $p:B\twoheadrightarrow A$, use the presentation-system identification for $p\pi$, the actual two-counit coinduction comparison for $\pi,p$, and this coefficient contraction before the canonical affine realization map. Require that this composite with $e$ equals the very same geometric atlas identification. This includes $h=1$, $h=0$, and zero-variable charts. It ties principal-open restriction to the presentation system even when a new inverse coordinate is necessary.
